posts.title: 1 Kings Chapter 19 verses 1-18
posts.description: 1 Kings 19:1–18 1 Kings 18 ends the story of Elijah and the battle of the prophets. Elijah has just facilitated God’s sign in lighting the drenched altar, and then killed the prophets of Baal. Right off the bat, we have Ahab living up to his pattern.
